findings.title: Covered-region bullet list does not restate the sha256 placeholder neutralization
findings.fix: Append to the coverage list: '(the sha256 field's 64 bytes are the "0".repeat(64) placeholder during both encode-time and verify-time hashing; see the Canonical hashing rule)' so the covered-region definition and the placeholder rule sit together.

findings.title: Verify step locates the sha256 span via a '64-byte lowercase-hex run' rather than strictly by the JSON key
findings.fix: Reword to 'locate the value span bound to the top-level JSON key sha256 (position derivable from the parsed key's offset in the raw metadata bytes; uniqueness guaranteed by the duplicate-key rejection)' so the span is defined by the key, not a hex-run heuristic.
